title: Hojin Ko Wins Outstanding Poster Award at KSIAM 2026
subtitle: Another poster award for Hojin Ko, following his recognition at KMS 2026.

sections.text: Hojin Ko received an Outstanding Poster Award at the 2026 Korean Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (KSIAM) Annual Meeting, held at Jeju Convention Center from November 5 to 8. The award was presented on November 7.
sections.html: Hojin Ko received an Outstanding Poster Award at the 2026 Korean Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (KSIAM) Annual Meeting, held at Jeju Convention Center from November 5 to 8. The award was presented on November 7.

sections.text: His award-winning poster was titled “Knowing When Not to Trade: Latent No-Trade Region Recovery Hidden in Neural Control.”
sections.html: His award-winning poster was titled “Knowing When Not to Trade: Latent No-Trade Region Recovery Hidden in Neural Control.”

sections.text: This follows his Outstanding Poster Award at the KMS Fall Meeting 2026. Congratulations to Hojin on another excellent achievement! 👏
